detail: Consistency: user-profile's ProfileScreen adopts the shared `FormScreenShell` (centered `max-w-3xl` like all other settings screens, was left-aligned `max-w-5xl`). DataTable now sits on `bg-card` instead of a transparent surface — on themes with a colored page background (e.g. cream) lists previously didn't match the white cards; now they do. - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web@0.123.2 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework@0.123.2 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live@0.123.2 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless@0.123.2 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer@0.123.2
